usage.callShape: POST https://gg402.vercel.app/communication_style_analyzer with JSON body {"text_sample":"<the text to analyze>"}

inputExample.text_sample: Hey can you please send me the report when you get a chance, thanks

usage.outputShape: body.style (string, e.g. "Passive-Indirect"), body.tips[] (array of improvement-tip strings), body.processedAt (ISO timestamp)
quirks: Registry surface lists method as GET, but GET returns 404 'Cannot GET /communication_style_analyzer' (no charge). The endpoint is actually POST.
The input field MUST be named text_sample (not text). Sending {text:...} pays then 400s with: field text_sample 'expected string, received undefined'.
x402 payment is 0.01 USDC (10000 base units) on Base (eip155:8453); price shown as 'Varies' in registry but observed flat $0.01.
usage.guide: Call POST https://gg402.vercel.app/communication_style_analyzer with a JSON body containing the single field text_sample set to the text whose communication style you want analyzed. Do NOT use GET (it 404s) and do NOT name the field text (it 400s). Payment is x402, ~0.01 USDC on Base. Read the result from body.style for the classified style label and body.tips[] for the array of actionable improvement suggestions.
